# ONNX Runtime C API headers

Compilation-only headers vendored from the official Microsoft ONNX Runtime
`v1.24.4` tag. AgPlayer does not link an ONNX Runtime import library and does
not distribute `onnxruntime.dll` or model binaries through this target.

- `onnxruntime_c_api.h`: SHA-256 `9ed0d7054a4e74249467365b25b415d36f51a44a6349e2a994a1812e4723d1e2`
- `onnxruntime_ep_c_api.h`: SHA-256 `e94ac3490697bdb107844fa9d403952ee7136134132a057eae5c1207b57ce352`
- `dml_provider_factory.h`: SHA-256 `893ddb645545bddad8c3f24bb768e97651c9ce45ec22076b435439889e4228c8`

Source: <https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.24.4/include/onnxruntime>
